# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
# Test data: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
# Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-27; see LICENSE and README.md.
# Reads the pinned test script; never evaluates LogQL or derives expectations.
# Run: mise exec -- elixir label-boolean-producer.exs.txt label_filters.logqltest

[path] = System.argv()
lines = path |> File.read!() |> String.split("\n")

labels = fn text ->
  Map.new(Regex.scan(~r/(\w+)=("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")/, text), fn [_, key, value] ->
    {key, JSON.decode!(value)}
  end)
end

{fixtures, _} =
  for {first, last} <- [{902, 1039}, {1181, 1196}],
      {line, i} <- lines |> Enum.slice((first - 1)..(last - 1)) |> Enum.with_index(first),
      text = line |> String.split(" #") |> hd() |> String.trim(),
      text != "" and not String.starts_with?(text, "#"),
      reduce: {[], nil} do
    {done, current} ->
      cond do
        text == "clear" ->
          done = if current, do: done ++ [current], else: done
          {done, %{"source_start" => i, "loads" => [], "cases" => []}}

        text == "load" ->
          {done, current}

        String.starts_with?(text, "eval ") ->
          fields =
            Regex.named_captures(
              ~r/^eval (?:(?<instant>instant) at (?<time>\d+)s|range from (?<start>\d+)s to (?<end>\d+)s step (?<step>\d+)s) (?<query>.+)$/,
              text
            )

          true = fields != nil
          instant? = fields["instant"] == "instant"

          row = %{
            "source_start" => i,
            "source_end" => i,
            "query" => fields["query"],
            "instant" => instant?,
            "expected" => [],
            "start" => String.to_integer(if(instant?, do: fields["time"], else: fields["start"])),
            "end" => String.to_integer(if(instant?, do: fields["time"], else: fields["end"])),
            "step" => if(instant?, do: 0, else: String.to_integer(fields["step"]))
          }

          {done, Map.update!(current, "cases", &(&1 ++ [row]))}

        current["cases"] == [] ->
          fields =
            Regex.named_captures(
              ~r/^(?<labels>\{.*?\})\s+(?<line>"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")\s+@ (?<start>\d+)s(?: \[repeat every (?<every>\d+)s for (?<count>\d+)\])?(?: \[metadata (?<metadata>.*)\])?$/,
              text
            )

          true = fields != nil

          load = %{
            "labels" => labels.(fields["labels"]),
            "line" => JSON.decode!(fields["line"]),
            "start" => String.to_integer(fields["start"]),
            "every" => if(fields["every"] == "", do: 0, else: String.to_integer(fields["every"])),
            "count" => if(fields["count"] == "", do: 1, else: String.to_integer(fields["count"])),
            "metadata" => labels.(fields["metadata"])
          }

          {done, Map.update!(current, "loads", &(&1 ++ [load]))}

        true ->
          cases =
            List.update_at(current["cases"], -1, fn row ->
              row = Map.put(row, "source_end", i)

              if String.starts_with?(text, "expect fail msg: ") do
                Map.put(row, "reject", String.replace_prefix(text, "expect fail msg: ", ""))
              else
                [_, names, samples] = Regex.run(~r/^(\{.*\})\s+([\d_ ]+)$/, text)

                Map.update!(
                  row,
                  "expected",
                  &(&1 ++ [%{"labels" => labels.(names), "values" => String.split(samples)}])
                )
              end
            end)

          {done, Map.put(current, "cases", cases)}
      end
  end
  |> then(fn {done, current} -> {done ++ [current], nil} end)

5 = length(fixtures)
36 = Enum.sum(Enum.map(fixtures, &length(&1["cases"])))
IO.puts(JSON.encode!(%{"revision" => "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d", "fixtures" => fixtures}))
